meta.project: AI-AAC (Artificial Intelligence - Augmentative and Alternative Communication)

product_overview: AI-AAC is a web-based communication tool designed to assist individuals with speech difficulties by generating contextual and relevant vocabulary using AI, enabling sentence construction via an intuitive drag-and-drop interface, and converting text to voice for enhanced communication accessibility.
core_goals: Enable users to generate approximately 100 contextually relevant AAC vocabulary words from text descriptions or photos.
Provide an intuitive drag-and-drop interface optimized for desktop and mobile/tablet for building sentences from generated words.
Offer AI-powered predictions for next words to assist in sentence formation.
Generate multiple grammatically correct sentence variations based on user-selected vocabulary.
Integrate emojis to enhance visual communication and accessibility of vocabulary.
Support speech synthesis through browser-based text-to-speech for AAC users.
Ensure accessibility and usability across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices with touch and mouse support.
Allow user customization including API key management, theme settings, and font size for personalized experience.
key_features: AI-Powered Vocabulary Generation using OpenAI embeddings and semantic analysis with category classification and MMR diversification algorithms.
Image analysis via GPT-4o-mini vision API to generate context descriptions from uploaded photos supporting multiple image formats with resizing and conversion.
Interactive drag-and-drop UI supporting mouse and touch events with iOS/iPad specific optimizations.
Emoji integration automatically adding relevant emojis to vocabulary terms to improve comprehension and engagement.
Next word prediction API that suggests up to 15 contextual next words based on current sentence context.
Sentence generation module producing 15-20 grammatically correct variations maintaining core meaning to aid communication.
Search and filter capabilities within vocabulary lists with expandable/collapsible categories for organization.
Text-to-Speech integration using browser Web Speech API to read individual words or entire sentences aloud.
Settings panel allowing configuration for OpenAI API keys, dark mode toggle, font size adjustment, and high contrast mode.
Local storage persistence to save user settings such as API key and display preferences for consistent sessions.
user_flow_summary: User opens the web app and optionally enters a text context or uploads a photo to generate contextual vocabulary terms with emojis.
User browses vocabulary organized by categories, uses search to find specific words, and drags desired words onto the sentence canvas.
User can reorder and remove words on the canvas using mouse or touch gestures, with support for long-press drag on mobile devices.
User may type custom words not present in generated vocabulary directly into the canvas.
User requests AI to generate multiple sentence variations based on selected words and browses the generated sentences.
User can click on individual words, suggestions, or sentences to activate text-to-speech playback with selectable voices.
User accesses settings to configure API keys, theme preferences, and use accessibility features like high contrast mode.
User completes sentences with aid from next word suggestions and focus mode toggles to optimize interface layout either on desktop or mobile devices.
validation_criteria: Generated vocabulary must include approximately 100 contextually relevant terms with accurate emoji associations and proper category distribution.
Image analysis must produce relevant context descriptions within 5-10 seconds and generate appropriate vocabulary.
Drag-and-drop sentence construction must work smoothly on desktop (mouse) and mobile/tablet (touch with long-press) devices with responsive reordering and removal capabilities.
Next word suggestions should update dynamically with low latency (1-2 seconds) and provide meaningful high-frequency AAC vocabulary.
Generated sentences must be grammatically correct, preserve core meaning, and offer 15-20 valid variations per input set.
Text-to-speech functionality must read individual words and full sentences instantly with user-selected voice preferences.
Search and filter functions should respond in real-time and properly filter vocabulary terms.
Settings panel inputs must persist user choices in local storage and apply immediately, including API key validation and UI theme changes.
System must handle invalid API keys, rate limiting (when enabled), and provide clear error messages without service disruption.
All interactive elements must meet accessibility standards including keyboard navigation, screen reader compatibility, touch target sizing, and color contrast adhering to WCAG 2.1 AA.
Performance targets include vocabulary generation in 15-30 seconds, image analysis in 5-10 seconds, sentence generation in 3-5 seconds, and instantaneous speech playback.

features.name: AI-Powered Vocabulary Generation
features.description: Main feature that generates contextually relevant AAC vocabulary words using OpenAI embeddings and semantic analysis. Uses term ranking, categorization, and diversity algorithms to produce 100 relevant terms.

features.name: Context-Based Term Generation API Endpoint
features.description: Flask endpoint that accepts context text and returns vocabulary terms with emojis. Handles API key validation, rate limiting, and error handling.

features.name: Sentence Generation from Selected Words
features.description: Takes user-selected vocabulary words and generates 18-20 grammatically correct sentence variations. Validates that sentences preserve core meaning while allowing grammatical flexibility.

features.name: Next Word Prediction/Suggestions
features.description: Provides smart word suggestions based on currently selected words to help users build sentences. Returns high-frequency AAC vocabulary with emojis.

features.name: Image Analysis for Context
features.description: Uploads and analyzes images using GPT-4o-mini vision API to generate context descriptions. Supports JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, HEIC formats with automatic resizing and format conversion.

features.name: Interactive Drag-and-Drop UI
features.description: Web-based AAC interface with touch and mouse support. Features word bank, canvas for building sentences, suggestions panel, and sentence display. Includes iOS/iPad optimizations.

features.name: Emoji Integration
features.description: Automatically adds relevant emojis to vocabulary terms using GPT-4o-mini to improve visual communication and accessibility.

features.name: Term Embeddings and Similarity Search
features.description: Uses OpenAI text-embedding-3-small model to compute semantic embeddings for context and terms. Performs cosine similarity calculations for relevance scoring.

features.name: Term Categorization System
features.description: Classifies vocabulary terms into categories (Action/Task, Tech/Tool, Problem/Error, Data/Artifact, Concept/Method, Event/Logistics) using NLP and pattern matching.

features.name: MMR Diversification Algorithm
features.description: Implements Maximal Marginal Relevance to ensure vocabulary diversity while maintaining relevance. Balances semantic similarity with novelty using category quotas.

features.name: Text Normalization and Lemmatization
features.description: Normalizes terms using spaCy for deduplication and variation matching. Handles inflections, possessives, synonyms, and pronoun families.

features.name: Rate Limiting System
features.description: Implements API key-based rate limiting (20 requests per 5 minutes) with SHA256 hashing for privacy. Configurable and currently disabled by default.

features.name: API Key Management
features.description: Supports both server-side and user-provided OpenAI API keys. Validates keys and provides appropriate error messages.

features.name: Sentence Validation and Repair
features.description: Validates generated sentences to ensure they contain required words or acceptable variants. Falls back to deterministic reconstruction if validation fails.

features.name: Touch and Mobile Support
features.description: Comprehensive touch event handling for iPad and mobile devices. Includes drag-and-drop, touch targets sized for accessibility, iOS viewport fixes, and haptic feedback.

features.name: Settings Panel
features.description: User configuration interface for API key entry, dark mode toggle, font size adjustment, and high contrast mode.

features.name: Text-to-Speech Integration
features.description: Browser-based Web Speech API integration to read sentences aloud for AAC users.

features.name: Local Storage Persistence
features.description: Saves user preferences (API key, theme settings, font size) to browser local storage for session persistence.
